name: Drinking Buddy [Teamwork]
body:
You and your allies have almost preternatural luck when you’ve all had a few drinks.

Benefit(s): Once per day, if you or your allies are drunk (or worse) within 10 feet of each other and are also drunk (or worse), your or your allies can reroll one d20 roll as a free action. The second result must be taken, even if it is worse.

Polymorph: Spiritual Ally, © 2026, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: G. Tyler Ernst.
